integrity: The sharp lower bound is formal from preservation of definable closure; the degree-two witness is extracted from the published generic-binary-function construction. The bundled verifier checks only the finite combinatorial core.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the minimum among finite algebraic witness tuples and does not assert that every failure has a degree-two witness or that a real singleton suffices. The synthesis is short and may be uncatalogued folklore.
title: Degree two is the minimal algebraic obstruction to dividing extension
